title: The align leaf prints one row per iteration in progressive seeding
body:
With `--seed-mode prog`, each iteration runs one `mmseqs align` over a shrinking active set, with `n_take` doubling. The tree summed the iterations into one leaf. The word is iteration, not round.

## Proposal

Record each iteration's align duration in a `Vec` on `Stats`, since the enum array has a fixed size. Print one indented row per iteration under align, and `[N iterations]` on the align line.

## Open

- Jack judges on real output whether the rows are too busy. If they go, the bracketed count stays.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/415c993d
notes.text: Committed on `runtime-tree`. The rows show wall time only, with no share.
